question.text: Interest income from corporate bonds/debentures held by Cat III AIF is:

answer.text: Taxable at the unit holders' applicable income tax slab rates

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3.1, interest income is taxable in the hands of unit holders at their applicable slab rates. The Trap: Exempt/zero/MMR-only are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-check with Cat I/II treatment. Distributor's Pro-Tip: TDS on interest may be applied at fund level; communicate to investors for tax filing.
